headline: Batch started: room made, weights arriving, two recipes under way
subhead: Six recipes from the Hugging Face trending list of 2026-11-22. 56 GB moved off the fast drive, the SenseNova engine is built, and the first two recipe agents are preparing while their weights download.

tiles.name: qwen38-27b-family
tiles.note: Trending #5, #18, #19, #31. Four finetunes of one 27B base; tuned once on pi-adapted. Two are uncensored.

tiles.name: inkling-2-mini-uncensored
tiles.note: Trending #6 and #85. LoRA on the IQ4_NL already on disk, plus the baked AD-Q4_K file.

tiles.name: sensenova-loop-9b
tiles.note: Trending #10. Looped 9B, fits in VRAM. Needs llama.cpp PR #32588. Abliterated variant included.

tiles.name: maxwell-v1-flash
tiles.note: Trending #17. 35B MoE, 3B active. Needs the AtomicChat port patch on d3c3e242c. Uncensored LoRA included.

tiles.name: nemotron-bolt-e4b
tiles.note: Trending #28. 8B, all in VRAM, stock llama.cpp.

tiles.name: qwen35-9b-heretic
tiles.note: Trending #30. Uncensored 9B with an MTP head, all in VRAM.

streams.name: Downloads
streams.note: 19 pinned files in trending order, resumable, sha256 checked. See plate 1.

streams.name: Move aside
streams.note: hf-native 19 G, hf-fp16 8.5 G, stale-oct25 4.2 G done; unsloth/old 24 G in progress. Symlinks left at the old paths.

streams.name: Duplicate check

streams.name: Engine builds
streams.note: pr32588-0ba8e4adf built for SenseNova. Maxwell port build is next.

streams.name: Recipe agents
streams.note: 27B family (port 8101) and Inkling uncensored (port 8102). Each follows the inference-optimisation skill.

streams.name: Thread mining
streams.note: Two reports in: 8 recurring tasks in this repo's threads, 13 across the other projects.

streams.name: Skills
streams.note: Being written from the mining reports, split into shareable and this-machine-only.

streams.name: 2 TB drive
streams.note: Journaled HFS+, so Linux mounts it read-only. Not mounted. Batch does not depend on it.

storage_note: Fast drive went from 27 GB to 52 GB free so far; the last 24 GB of the move is still copying. The archive HDD takes what moves aside. Nothing was deleted.
